SELECT p.Name, p.Age 
FROM `pilot` p
JOIN `match` m ON p.`Pilot_Id` = m.`Winning_Pilot`
WHERE p.Age < 30
GROUP BY p.`Pilot_Id`, p.Name, p.Age
ORDER BY COUNT(m.`Round`) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.Name, p.Age 
FROM `pilot` p
JOIN `match` m ON p.`Pilot_Id` = m.`Winning_Pilot`
GROUP BY p.`Pilot_Id`, p.Name, p.Age
HAVING COUNT(m.`Round`) = (
    SELECT MAX(win_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(m2.`Round`) AS win_count
        FROM `match` m2
        JOIN `pilot` p2 ON m2.`Winning_Pilot` = p2.`Pilot_Id`
        WHERE p2.Age < 30
        GROUP BY p2.`Pilot_Id`
    ) AS win_counts
)
AND p.Age < 30;
